text: {"lessons":["Five periods of falling account value are a reminder that stocks can decline for sustained stretches; I should not assume a rebound is imminent.","Doing nothing avoids impulsive trades, but holding through losses is still an active risk choice; I should review my holdings and their risks each period.","With no company or market information beyond prices, I should avoid pretending I can forecast winners and make measured decisions rather than chase short-term moves."]}
